subject: Renewal + Premium SLA onramp / capacity uplift for Clearwave Analytics
messages:

Cc: Priya Raman <priya.raman@clearwave.ai>, Maya Singh <m.singh@procure-clearwave.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T09:13:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal window + capacity uplift questions

Hi Jasmine,

We’re nearing our renewal on July 15 and I wanted to flag two asks from Clearwave leadership:

1) We expect a 2x usage increase in Q4 (new search feature + more concurrent inference). We need a clear path to guaranteed capacity and predictable latency under peak.
2) We’re interested in Redwood’s Premium SLA (lower latency SLO, faster response for incidents) — need cost + timelines.

Can you share a draft of the SLA addendum and a rough cost estimate for reserved capacity that meets a 95th percentile latency target of <=120ms on our current workload? Also looping in procurement (Maya) and Priya (platform) to coordinate PO and technical validation.

Thanks,
Ethan

Ethan Cole
VP Product, Clearwave Analytics
ethan.cole@clearwave.ai

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-04T09:46:00-07:00
Subject: Cost model for 2x uplift (preliminary)

All — I modeled three scenarios based on Clearwave’s forecast (Ethan):

A) Reserved Dedicated pool sized for steady-state 2x peak: ~ $27,500 / month; 30-day lead time to reserve hardware.
B) Reserved + burst credit: $19,800 / month + $0.08/token burst unit; faster to provision (~14 days) and more cost-efficient for spiky load.
C) Hosted with aggressive autoscaling + Premium SLA overlay: $12,000 baseline + potential overage; latency guarantees require a capacity reservation or stronger routing fallback.

Latency projection (95th pctl) using our test workload: A -> 95th ~108ms, B -> ~120–135ms depending on burst utilization, C -> 120–160ms.

Recommendations: push for option B (good cost/latency tradeoff) and include a short-term capacity reservation for Q4 high-risk windows.

I’ll prepare a one-pager for the call.

-ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Clearwave_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Priya Raman <priya.raman@clearwave.ai>

Subject: Re: Renewal window + capacity uplift questions

Thanks — helpful. A few procurement/technical clarifications before our call:

- Can you confirm whether the Premium SLA addendum supports dedicated regional capacity (us-west) and private peering?
- For pricing, we need a line-item PO-ready quote for both the reserved pool and the burst credits.
- We’re sensitive to contract length — our CFO prefers 12 months but is open to a 24-month with a price cap.

Also: please include a summary of rollback/fallback behavior if the Dedicated pool hits saturation during a launch.

—Priya
Priya Raman
Principal Platform Engineer, Clearwave

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Team — jumping in to confirm ops commitments and onboarding timeline. Quick points:

1) Regional capacity & peering: yes, we can allocate a us-west Dedicated pool and enable PrivateLink/peering. Aditya — we’ll need a 10-business-day lead to spin up the reserved nodes and validate throughput.
2) Rollback/fallback: default is automated routing to compatible hosted variants with degraded latency but continued availability; we’ll document blackout windows and a manual hotfix runbook for rapid scaling.
3) SLA contract term: suggest 12 months with an optional 12-month renewal ladder to hit CFO asks; include an explicit price-cap clause for year 2 as an option.

I’ll draft the operational annex and a phased onboarding schedule to be included in the mutual action plan.

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Operations, Redwood Inference
